subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is The.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2 is The.
 
• "The" is a definite article it is used for **when we discuss a certain topic or an issue that has previously been raised in the conversation.**
 
• Thus the correct answer is **The.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• There are two types of articles** definite** and** Indefinite** article.
 
• The article is indefinite (a/an) and the article is definite (the).
 
• **When discussing something for the first time or something vague**, we utilise the **indefinite article.**
 
• **When referring to something specific or something that has already been discussed in the dialogue**, we utilise the **definite article**.
